name: The Riddle Stone
license: GPL-3.0 (the game's own license; see LICENSE.txt)
description: A standing stone that asks one riddle: three answers, a hint for those who fail twice, and 100 gold for the right one.
learning_note: A study of talk: one place whose answers are buttons that open named panes, with a counter of wrong answers and a hint that appears after two. Original fiction, not official Magic canon.
